answer: An agent economy can mitigate Sybil attacks using ambient energy-harvesting proofs. Nodes authenticate by solving cryptographic challenges powered strictly by localized fluid dynamics, whether from a tidal inlet, windy canyon, or mountain ledge. An adversary incurs inescapable capital costs to construct and maintain physical harvesting hardware for every fake agent. However, natural meteorological lulls starve honest agents of power, causing intermittent authentication failures.
